messages:
jordan: FYI team — proposing a short, staged maintenance for the inference control-plane that touches routing and cache invalidation. Goal: rotate a problematic routing rule and flush stale KV prefixes. Window suggestion: 2026-04-02 02:00-03:00 UTC (1 hour). Minimal traffic regions only during first 15m for canary, then full.

mia: Ack. Can we run the canary against dedicated staging clusters first? want to validate fallback logic and no double-evict of KV.

kevin: +1 on staging canary. Also recommend a 15m read-only probe before any write invalidate. I can wire a smoke test that runs 5m prior and 5m after.

oncall-bot: Incident/Pager note: planned-maintenance scheduled by jordan for 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z. Pager escalation suppressed for scheduled window per policy. Use #eng-oncall for live updates.

kevin: I'll post the smoke test snippet here so SREs can run it if needed:

```bash
# smoke test: verify routing & kv behavior
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/test-run \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' \
  -d '{"prompt":"ping","check_cache":true}' | jq .status
```

sre-lead: Important notes for the runbook: 1) canary on one control-plane zone, 2) monitor latency P50/P95 and error 5xx; abort if P95 increases > 200ms or 5xx spike > 0.5%. 3) have rollback script ready to restore previous routing rule.

jordan: Adding rollback command here (ops runbook):

```bash
# rollback routing rule
redwoodctl routes set --policy previous --selector control-plane-zone=usw1
# rehydrate KV from snapshot
redwoodctl kv restore --snapshot-id "pre-rotate-$(date -u +%s)"
```

product-comms: Draft customer copy for status page & emails below. Please review for tone and accuracy. We should not call out internal tokens like KV by name in customer-facing copy; keep it high-level.

```text
Status page update (Draft):
Scheduled maintenance: brief control-plane configuration update
Start: 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC
Expected duration: up to 60 minutes
Impact: Some requests may experience transient routing retries or slight latency elevation during a small subset of requests. No data loss expected. Production traffic will be gradually rolled through a canary first and then the broader fleet. We will post updates here and notify affected customers if we observe any sustained degradation.
```

customer-success: Suggest adding an explicit note for Dedicated customers: "If you have reserved capacity or strict SLAs, contact your CS rep before the window if you need a different window." Also include a link to our incident contact form.

ops-bot: NOTE: create pre-rotation snapshots of KV prefixes: `kv-snapshot-2800004321` -> saved to customer-snapshots bucket. Automation will tag snapshots with retention 7d.

sre-lead: Live mitigation plan in-thread:
- t=0 (02:00): start canary in control-plane-zone=usw1, no customer traffic until smoke passes.
- t=+15m: if smoke ok, roll to 20% traffic, monitor 5m.
- t=+30m: expand to 50% if metrics stable.
- t=+45m: expand to full, finish housekeeping.
Abort criteria: P95 > +200ms vs baseline OR 5xx rate increase > 0.5% absolute OR any customer reports of request failures via #support.

mia: For the oncall handoff — who's owning the first 30m? jordan or kevin?

jordan: I'll own the canary phase (first 30m). kevin you take the expansion and rollback if needed. If both of us are paged, escalate to sre-lead.

oncall-bot: @jordan has been assigned the active lead for this maintenance. Pager rules remain suppressed; manual pages only if abort criteria hit.

kevin: I'll prepare the A/B status message variants for the status page depending on outcome (success, partial degrade, abort). Posting drafts here so product-comms can pick language.

product-comms: Thanks — copy looks good. Minor edit: change "slight latency elevation" -> "brief latency increase for a small portion of requests". Also include TL;DR at top for customers.

jordan: Final checklist before we publish comms:
- [x] staging canary test ready
- [x] rollback script staged and tested
- [x] KV snapshots automated (ops-bot confirmed)
- [ ] legal/infosec sign-off (awaiting reply from sec)
- [ ] status page & customer email scheduled (product-comms)

customer-success: I'll queue a small targeted email to Dedicated customers with SLA mention and contact link. Will send once sec sign-off is in.

sre-lead: Last note: after completion, collect a short post-maint summary for the internal incident log with metrics (P50/P95, 5xx counts) and customer impact tickbox. We don't need a full postmortem unless abort happened.

jordan: Great. I'll publish the status page draft in ~30m and ping this thread when it's live. Thanks everyone. :thanks:

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-04-02T01:45:00Z — 15m pre-maintenance reminder will be posted to this channel.
